operations.name: Covering Force
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: Commander, the Pact crossed the border at oh-four-hundred. Our covering force holds the Fulda corridor. Trade space for time, keep the cavalry alive, and hold the crossroads until the brigade is up.

operations.name: Hold at Huenfeld
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: The covering force bought us the time we needed. The brigade is in position east of Huenfeld. The motor rifle regiment will come straight at us. Take the objectives and hold them.

operations.name: Delay to the Vogelsberg
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: We lost the crossroads. The lead tank regiment is pushing west in the rain. Fall back toward the Vogelsberg and bleed every company that follows. Do not lose the brigade.

operations.name: Counterattack
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: The line held and corps has released the heavy brigade. We counterattack at first light. Retake the villages along the main road before the second echelon closes up.

operations.name: The Second Line
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: We are on the second line now. The enemy will try a night attack with fresh tanks. Use the thermals. Hold the high ground and let them come to us.

operations.name: Air Assault
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: Their airborne battalion has landed behind us. Air cavalry is attached. Find them, pin them, and clear the landing zones before they link up with the main body.

operations.name: Rearguard
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: Fog is rolling in and a forward detachment is trying to cut the road behind us. The rearguard is yours. Destroy that detachment or we lose the way out.

operations.name: Restore the Border
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: The enemy is falling back to the border. Their tank division is covering the withdrawal. Push through it and put us back on the inner German border.

operations.name: Last Line
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: This is the last line before the Rhine crossings. Reinforcements land in two days. Hold here through the night, whatever it costs.

operations.name: Exploitation
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: Their front is breaking. Corps wants the last motor rifle regiment destroyed before it can regroup. Finish it.

operations.name: Relief
operations.speaker: Brigade S3
operations.briefing: The reinforcing division is coming up behind us. One more attack, Commander. Take back the crossroads and hand them the line intact.

operations.name: Breakout
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: Sir, the bombers are finished and the line in front of us is broken. Push the combat command through the gap and take the road junction before the Germans can close it.

operations.name: Into the Bocage
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: We are through. The hedgerow country is ahead. The infantry leads, the tanks follow close. Take the hamlets one field at a time.

operations.name: Hold the Bridgehead
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: The breakout stalled and a panzer division is counterattacking in the rain. Dig in around the bridgehead and keep the bazookas forward.

operations.name: Armored Thrust
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: Their reconnaissance battalion is all that stands between us and open country. Run it down and keep moving.

operations.name: Counterstroke
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: The panzers are overextended. We hit them in the flank this morning. Destroy them in the open before they reach cover.

operations.name: River Crossing
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: The cavalry has found a crossing under the fog. Get across, seize the far bank, and hold it for the engineers.

operations.name: Close Air Support
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: The weather has cleared and the fighter-bombers are ours today. Use them. Break the attack on the ridge before it starts.

operations.name: Encirclement
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: The pocket is closing. What is left of their panzer division is trying to break out. Do not let it.

operations.name: The Long Night
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: Snow and a long night ahead. They will attack before dawn. Hold the village and keep the guns registered on the approaches.

operations.name: Pursuit
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: The enemy is in full retreat. Pursue, take the last crossroads, and do not give them time to form a line.

operations.name: Turning Point
operations.speaker: Combat Command S3
operations.briefing: Reinforcements are up and the weather is turning. We attack at dawn. Take back everything we gave up.

operations.name: Suwalki Gap
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: Commander, battalion tactical groups crossed into the gap an hour ago. Expect drones overhead and jamming on every net. Hold the corridor until the armored brigade arrives.

operations.name: Armored Response
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: The armored brigade is up. The motor rifle brigade is digging in on the high ground. Take it back before their artillery is registered.

operations.name: Delay in Depth
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: We could not hold the corridor. Tanks are coming through in the rain. Delay in depth, use the Javelins, and keep your formations dispersed.

operations.name: Counter-Battery
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: Their guns are hitting the road junction. Find the batteries, silence them, and then take the junction.

operations.name: Night Defense
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: They will attack at night. Our thermals see further than theirs. Hold the ridge and make them pay for every kilometer.

operations.name: Air Assault
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: Their attack helicopters are hunting our supply routes. Aviation brigade is attached. Clear the sky and secure the landing zones.

operations.name: Under the Fog
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: Fog grounds everything that flies today. A battalion group is moving to cut our rear. Find it and destroy it.

operations.name: Breakthrough
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: Their tank army is committed. Division wants us through the gap before their second echelon arrives. Break through.

operations.name: Hold the Line
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: Snow tonight and an attack before morning. Allied reinforcements are a day out. Hold the line.

operations.name: Restore the Border
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: The last brigade on our side of the border is cut off. Destroy it and the border is ours again.

operations.name: Reinforcement
operations.speaker: Brigade Operations Officer
operations.briefing: The allied division is behind us now. One more attack. Take back the gap and hand them the line.
